title: Blown out of a special electronics helicopter hit by an RPG near Pleiku
summary: Joe McMoneagle tells of Blown out of a special electronics helicopter hit by an RPG near Pleiku, about late 1967 at Pleiku, Vietnam, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a former Army soldier, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that in late 1967 near Pleiku in Vietnam he was riding in a special electronics helicopter when it was hit in the belly by an RPG, a shoulder-fired rocket grenade. He says the blast blew the helicopter apart and threw him out. It is part of the story of his own life and what he says he survived.
